protocol: Read all three staging products; fresh DataFrames each trial; join, aggregate and write fine/coarse/class Parquet to distinct paths. No persisted inputs/results. Timer excludes Spark startup and post-write correctness comparison. One warmup and three measured repetitions; small-sample P95 descriptive only. OS cache uncontrolled. Sequential scenarios; local execution, not distributed cluster scaling. Every output must equal the independent preserved key-join reference.
